ValidationRule.description: Locks a BAN's currency once it's tagged to a quote (it must keep matching the quotes/orders using it). Admins with Edit_BAN_Currency can override. Doesn't fire on create or on untagged BANs.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This billing account is already tagged to a quote, so its currency can't be changed. It must stay the same currency as the quotes and orders that use it. Contact an admin if a correction is genuinely required.
